message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO," dated "30 NOVEMBER-6 DESEMBER 2015." The main title at the top reads "RIWAYAT TERORIS PARIS DI INDONESIA." A large subheadline states "DIA YANG DITUDING," followed by text mentioning "Hasil audit Petral," "Riza Chalid," and "Pertamina."

The central image features a man with a mustache, dark hair, and a dark jacket, crouching next to a large red oil drum. The drum is positioned upside-down on a dark stand, resembling a water dispenser. It has a white band in the middle featuring a logo composed of blue, green, and red shapes. A blue tap is attached to the bottom of the drum. The man is pressing the lever of the tap with his right index finger, while holding a small red cup with his left hand to catch liquid from the spout. He has a stern facial expression, looking toward the viewer. The background consists of dark gray walls and a light brown wooden floor. A barcode and price "RP 39.500" are in the bottom-left corner.
